name: superpowerpoint
description: Composable skills for planning, building, editing and reviewing editable PowerPoint presentations.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build and review editable PowerPoint decks.
interface.longDescription: Six composable skills cover briefs, storyboards, design, editable authoring, careful revisions and evidence-based review. Includes a local PPTX inspector. A presentation engine is required to create or render slides.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $superpowerpoint to create or improve my PowerPoint presentation.
